panels.description: Displacement relative to the first measurement: For each timestamp, the displacement in each coordinate (easting, northing, height) is calculated relative to the first GPS measurement.

targets.rawSql:
WITH Deltas AS (
    SELECT
        measurement_timestamp as time,
        local_easting - AVG(local_easting) OVER (ORDER BY time ASC) AS delta_easting,
        local_northing - FIRST_VALUE(local_northing) OVER (ORDER BY time ASC) AS delta_northing,
        local_height - FIRST_VALUE(local_height) OVER (ORDER BY time ASC) AS delta_height
    FROM
        basetime_data.$GPS_Location
    ORDER BY time ASC
)
SELECT
    time,
    delta_height * 1000 AS "Vertical Displacement (mm)",
    (SQRT(POW(delta_easting, 2) + POW(delta_northing, 2))) * 1000 AS "Horizontal Displacement (mm)",
    (SQRT(POW(delta_easting, 2) + POW(delta_northing, 2) + POW(delta_height, 2))) * 1000 AS "Total 3D Displacment (mm)"

FROM
    Deltas
ORDER BY
    time ASC;

panels.title: Displacement Relative To The First Measurement $GPS_Location

panels.description:
Displacement between consecutive measurements: The function compares each value (easting, northing, height) with the previous row, and calculates the change in position between consecutive timestamps.

This helps you track movement over time, and you can detect trends or shifts in the data.

targets.rawSql:
WITH Deltas AS (
    SELECT
        measurement_timestamp AS time,
        local_easting - LAG(local_easting) OVER (ORDER BY measurement_timestamp ASC) AS delta_easting,
        local_northing - LAG(local_northing) OVER (ORDER BY measurement_timestamp ASC) AS delta_northing,
        local_height - LAG(local_height) OVER (ORDER BY measurement_timestamp ASC) AS delta_height
    FROM
        basetime_data.$GPS_Location
    ORDER BY time ASC
)
SELECT
    time,
    delta_height * 1000 AS "Vertical Displacement (mm)",
    (SQRT(POW(delta_easting, 2) + POW(delta_northing, 2))) * 1000 AS "Horizontal Displacement (mm)",
    (SQRT(POW(delta_easting, 2) + POW(delta_northing, 2) + POW(delta_height, 2))) * 1000 AS "Total 3D Displacement (mm)"
FROM
    Deltas
WHERE
    delta_easting IS NOT NULL 
ORDER BY
    time ASC;

panels.title: Cumulative Displacement (Relative to Previous Measurement) $GPS_Location

panels.description:
Moving Average:

Vertical Moving Average: The average of the last $Moving_Average values for vertical displacement.

Horizontal Moving Average: The average of the last $Moving_Average values for horizontal displacement.

Total 3D Moving Average: The average of the last $Moving_Average values for the total 3D displacement.

targets.rawSql:
WITH Deltas AS (
    SELECT
        measurement_timestamp AS time,
        local_easting - LAG(local_easting) OVER (ORDER BY measurement_timestamp ASC) AS delta_easting,
        local_northing - LAG(local_northing) OVER (ORDER BY measurement_timestamp ASC) AS delta_northing,
        local_height - LAG(local_height) OVER (ORDER BY measurement_timestamp ASC) AS delta_height
    FROM
        basetime_data.$GPS_Location
    ORDER BY time ASC
)
SELECT
    time,
    AVG(delta_height) OVER (ORDER BY time ASC ROWS BETWEEN $Moving_Average PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) * 1000 AS "Vertical Moving Avg (mm)",
    AVG(SQRT(POW(delta_easting, 2) + POW(delta_northing, 2))) OVER (ORDER BY time ASC ROWS BETWEEN $Moving_Average PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) * 1000 AS "Horizontal Moving Avg (mm)",
    AVG(SQRT(POW(delta_easting, 2) + POW(delta_northing, 2) + POW(delta_height, 2))) OVER (ORDER BY time ASC ROWS BETWEEN $Moving_Average PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) * 1000 AS "Total 3D Moving Avg (mm)"

FROM
    Deltas
WHERE
    delta_easting IS NOT NULL
Order by
    time ASC
